combo_label: In the Bathroom × Cheese × Norse Mythology

entries.clue: Live bacterial colony, the sort a yoghurt pot label boasts of, grown to acidify milk
Chalky white crust hard water leaves round a chrome fitting
Curved length of pipe holding water to block bad smells
Gritty mineral on the board used to file nails smooth
Fire giant with a blazing sword who rides from the south to burn the worlds at the end
Alpine speciality scraped molten over boiled potatoes and pickles
Tank behind the throne that sighs as it refills
Seasoning crystals rubbed through fresh solids to draw the water out
Whole millstone-shaped cheese, rolled about rather than carried
The goddess of love weeps them for her wandering husband, and they fall as red gold
Giantess who came armed for vengeance and stayed to laugh at a trickster tied to a goat
Goddess in a cat-drawn chariot who claims half the slain and owns the Brisingamen
